skill.name: gemini-computer-use
skill.description: Build and run Gemini Computer Use browser agents with Playwright, screenshot feedback, configurable actions, and model-requested safety confirmation.
skill.summary: Run a Playwright browser agent using Gemini Computer Use actions and screenshot feedback.
skill.author: am-will

security_audit.summary: All 35 static findings are false positives caused by empty credential placeholders, normal environment configuration, keyboard APIs, Markdown formatting, and example URLs. No embedded secret, certificate access, Ruby execution, or shell backtick execution is present. The agent still has high-impact design risks because it sends browser screenshots to Gemini and executes model-directed browser actions with limited local policy enforcement.

remediation.issue: Model-returned browser actions can execute without independent local approval.
remediation.suggestion: Require local confirmation for typing, key combinations, new-origin navigation, and consequential clicks, even when model safety metadata is absent.

remediation.issue: Screenshots and URLs may disclose sensitive or internal page content.
remediation.suggestion: Add host allowlists, block private network targets, warn before transmission, and provide screenshot redaction or region controls.

remediation.issue: Quick-start dependency installation is not version-pinned.
remediation.suggestion: Provide tested version constraints or a lock file, and document integrity verification for downloaded browser binaries.

content.user_title: Automate Browsers with Gemini Computer Use
content.value_statement: Browser automation agents require a reliable screenshot and action loop. This skill provides a Playwright runner with Gemini Computer Use actions and safety prompts.
actual_capabilities: Runs a screenshot, function call, browser action, and function response loop.
Supports navigation, clicking, hovering, typing, keyboard shortcuts, scrolling, and drag operations.
Configures the start URL, headless mode, viewport size, and turn limit.
Launches bundled Chromium, a browser channel, or a custom Chromium executable.
Prompts the user when Gemini marks an action as requiring confirmation.
Excludes selected predefined Computer Use actions through repeatable command options.
limitations: Requires a Gemini API key, network access, Python packages, and a Playwright browser installation.
Supports Chromium-based browsers and does not implement other browser engines.
Creates a fresh browser context without persistent profiles or saved authentication.
Sends screenshots to Gemini and relies on model-provided metadata for safety confirmation.

use_cases.title: Inspect Public Web Pages
use_cases.description: Collect visible titles, labels, and page states from public websites through browser interaction.

use_cases.title: Test Browser Workflows
use_cases.description: Exercise navigation, form entry, scrolling, and interface controls in a disposable Chromium session.

use_cases.title: Prototype Computer Use Agents
use_cases.description: Study a complete Gemini action loop before integrating browser control into a larger application.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Open [URL], identify the main page title, and report the visible result without entering information or clicking external links.

prompt_templates.title: Navigate a Public Site
prompt_templates.prompt: Open [URL], navigate to [section], and summarize the visible information. Stop before login, download, purchase, or submission actions.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Form Safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Open [URL] and enter the provided test data into [form]. Do not submit the form, and report each completed field.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Constrained Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Complete [goal] on [allowed domain]. Use only [allowed actions], stop on any new domain, and request confirmation before consequential changes.

output_examples.input: Open the documentation page and identify its main heading.
output_examples.output: The page opened successfully. The visible main heading is "Getting Started."

output_examples.input: Navigate to the pricing section and list the visible plan names.
Fill the test form but stop before submission.
output_examples.output: The requested test fields are filled. The form remains unsubmitted and awaits review.

best_practices: Use a disposable browser context and avoid accounts containing sensitive data.
Restrict allowed domains and exclude actions that are unnecessary for the task.
Keep turn limits low and review the browser before approving consequential actions.
anti_patterns: Do not expose passwords, payment details, private messages, or confidential pages to the agent.
Do not run open-ended tasks against internal networks or unrestricted websites.
Do not treat model safety metadata as the only approval control for consequential actions.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Gemini API key?
faq.answer: Yes. Set GEMINI_API_KEY in the environment before running the agent.

faq.question: Which browsers are supported?
faq.answer: The script supports bundled Chromium, configured Chrome or Edge channels, and custom Chromium-based executables.

faq.question: Does every risky action require confirmation?
faq.answer: No. The script prompts only when Gemini returns require_confirmation. Add independent approval controls for consequential actions.

faq.question: Does the agent use my existing browser profile?
faq.answer: No. It creates a fresh Playwright browser context and does not configure a persistent profile.

faq.question: What information is sent to Gemini?
faq.answer: The conversation includes the user prompt, browser screenshots, current URLs, action calls, and action results.

faq.question: Can I disable browser actions?
faq.answer: Yes. Repeat the exclude option for predefined actions that the model must not use.
